motion.name: book-opening
motion.purpose: Open the Blender book, hold the original landscape in monochrome, restore color and enter the picture; bypass under reduced motion.

motion.name: book-handoff
motion.purpose: Keep the final book view until the intro draws; Westwood and AkulaFlow continue on the same original landscape.

motion.name: book-rendering
motion.purpose: Render loading, resize, pointer movement and opening; stop when settled.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Start the adventure or open its book.

components.name: Options action
components.description: Menu, fullscreen, inventory and help controls inside the Options dialog, opened from the original HUD button.

components.name: Settings panel
components.description: Scrollable settings, help and inventory dialogs constrained to the game stage, with focus containment and Escape dismissal. Credits live inside Options.
components.css: .ds-panel{padding:24px;background:var(--panel,#14231d);color:var(--paper,#e7dcba);border:1px solid var(--edge,#786447);font:15px/1.6 Georgia,serif}.ds-panel h2{font:25px Georgia,serif;color:#e4ce97;margin:0 0 24px}.ds-panel p{margin:0}

components.name: Walk speed
components.description: Native select with a comfortable touch target.

components.name: Inventory slot
components.description: Touch-friendly slot in the internal inventory overlay; the real component supplies original item sprites and accessible item names.

narrative.overview: Old leather, wood, aged gold and emerald fittings make the browser feel part of Kyrandia. A Blender-modeled book carries the original retail cover embossed into leather; generated interface art supplies the surrounding fantasy controls. The original 320 × 200 game fills the stage once the camera enters the book, with no external masthead, toolbar or footer.
keyCharacteristics: Original cover art and pixel game scenes, with a physical Blender-modeled book as the entrance.
Warm shadows, parchment lettering and deep green controls.
Motion for opening the story and acknowledging input, not perpetual decoration.
rules: Use the original HUD Options button to launch internal dialogs; keep credits inside Options.
Show the transparent AkulaFlow intro mark over the original Kyrandia landscape used by Westwood, preserving the existing reveal and fade.

Use the original supplied retail cover as embossed leather on the Blender model; export via extractor/model_storybook.py to public/assets/interface/storybook.glb.gz and retain the editable .blend in ignored .reference/.
Fill the viewport with the table; place the candle behind the book on the right, outside the hinge arc.
dos: Do keep the game view unobscured outside explicitly opened dialogs and the next action visible.
Do keep controls and credits inside the game presentation.
Do preserve the original cursor, pixel density and scene framing.
Do check the book, menu, help and settings at desktop and narrow mobile sizes.
Do retain reduced-motion and WebGL-fallback paths.
Do preserve the supplied original cover composition and the original landscape through the book-to-intro handoff.
Do keep props outside the cover's hinge arc.
donts: Don't replace generated material art with generic gradients or decorative cards.
Don't add continuous book rendering, oversized downloads or ornamental controls without a functional reason.
